Class LogbackJsonEncoder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer>
io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.LogbackJsonEncoder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogEncoder
public final class LogbackJsonEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer>
A JSON encoder resembling Logback's own opinionated ch.qos.logback.classic.encoder.JsonEncoder.

Fields written: timestamp (epoch millis), nanoseconds (nanosecond-of-second, for sub-millisecond precision), level, threadName, loggerName, mdc (nested object of the event's key values), message (already formatted), and throwable (nested object with className, message and a stepArray of stack frame objects, recursing into cause if present).

Unlike Logback's encoder, which is independently configurable per field via <withXxx> elements, sequenceNumber is intentionally not implemented (Rainbow Gum has no context-wide sequence number generator, see %lsn/%sn in the pattern module discussion), context is omitted (Rainbow Gum has no equivalent to Logback's LoggerContext), and kvpList is omitted because Rainbow Gum does not distinguish MDC-origin key values from SLF4J fluent addKeyValue ones - both already end up merged into LogEvent.keyValues(), which this encoder writes as mdc.
